title: Codex and headless Claude Code inbound
description: No channel equivalent in Codex, and channels are ignored under claude -p. Options: Stop hook calling sock fetch (needs sock ack <ids> in sock-cli, loop guard via stop_hook_active, sender_id gate on owner_id), or sock listen --exec spawning claude -p. One consumer per puppet.

title: Managed Agents bridge: forward owner replies into sessions as user events
description: Daemon wrapping sock listen that sends owner replies into a Managed Agents session (beta header managed-agents-2026-04-01) and posts agent output via NotifyOwner. Needs own spec. Scaffold from rookery.
notes: 2026-10-14: spec written (docs/specs/integrations.md, 'Managed Agents bridge: sock-bridge'), local commit, not pushed: needs Guy's line. Design: a per-message sock listen --exec command, not a daemon (reuses listen's reconnect/ack/order; no rookery scaffold). Implementation next: refactor sock-runner's gate, lock and ledger into runner/lib.sh, then runner/sock-bridge with a fake Managed Agents server in test/.

title: Hooks: access_gate in CLI config.toml rides along to the plugin URL
description: cy4 unset ambient SOCK_ACCESS_GATE when the plugin token is used. The CLI also reads access_gate from config.toml and sends it as Sock-Access-Gate to the plugin URL. Needs a CLI flag or env to ignore the config file, or an isolated XDG_CONFIG_HOME that keeps url. Decide with sock-cli owner.
close_reason: Fixed: hook points XDG_CONFIG_HOME at a nonexistent path when the plugin supplies token and URL

title: Flaky: fake-sock tests hit 2s watchdog budget on slow first exec
description: TestTokenNeverInLog failed once with exit 143 (macOS first-exec delay). Set SOCK_HOOK_TIMEOUT=10 in TestTokenNeverInLog, TestTokenStraddlingCutIsRedacted, TestLogHasNoControlCharacters. Also drop 'root := root' in TestToolNamesExist and send no params field instead of null in drift client.

title: Hooks: SOCK_ACCESS_GATE / config.toml access_gate ride along to the plugin URL
description: notify.sh pairs token with URL but the CLI also reads SOCK_ACCESS_GATE and access_gate from config.toml and sends them to the chosen URL. Unset SOCK_ACCESS_GATE when the plugin token is used. Lower value secret.

title: notify.sh: strip control chars before first redaction in detail path
description: Final review: notify.sh detail path redacts raw stderr before stripping control chars, then cuts to 300 bytes; a token split by a control byte can leak a short prefix. Fix: pipe head -c 65536 through tr -d cntrl before redaction. Needs sock stderr to echo the token, so near-zero real risk.

title: sock CLI retries unavailable until killed
description: notify.sh hook measured: 'sock send' retries unavailable forever (3 requests in 2s, 5 in 12s) until the caller kills it. Hook has its own 10s watchdog so it is bounded, but the sock-cli owner should decide whether send needs an overall deadline. Found during integrations Task 1.

comments.author: Guy J Grigsby
comments.text: Measured and fixed in sock/cli sock-cli-cu7 (cli commit on main): retries were already bounded (6 attempts, ~16s) but had no overall budget and no give-up message. Now: 60s budget, 'the server is unavailable: gave up after 6 attempts'. Close when you agree.

title: Hosted MCP surfaces: Responses API, claude.ai, ChatGPT, Managed Agents cloud
description: sock-mcp is stdio only. These need a public Streamable HTTP endpoint and an OAuth-style credential (Responses API takes an OAuth access token in the authorization field; sock_pt_ untested there). Multi-tenant token proxy and OAuth layer need a security review. Revisit with a real need.
